notes.title: Huge Update for Nia: Jewel Hunter!
notes.content:
[h2]🌟 Huge Update for [b]Nia: Jewel Hunter[/b]![/h2][p]We’ve prepared lots of new features and improvements to make Nia’s adventures even more exciting:[/p][p]🎮 [b]Difficulty Modes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Easy[/b] — perfect for those who just want to enjoy the story and exploration without worrying about traps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Normal[/b] — a real test of your attention: plan your routes carefully, avoid dead ends, and don’t forget the door codes![/p][/*][/list][p]🗝️ [b]New Objects[/b]
Levels now feature additional elements to make exploration even more engaging.[/p][p]🌍 [b]New Localizations[/b]
The game is now available in [b]Polish[/b], [b]Czech[/b], and [b]Turkish[/b]![/p][p]⚡ [b]Optimization[/b]
Performance has been significantly improved on larger levels.[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Lots of Fixes[/b]
Bugs have been squashed and small tweaks added for a smoother experience.[/p]

notes.title: Update Today – Free Camera Mode + Improvements
notes.content: [p]In today's update, we've added a [b]Free Camera Mode[/b] to help you plan your route more comfortably.[/p][p]We’re aware that on some levels it’s possible to get stuck without any warning from the game. We're actively working on a solution to improve this experience.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172227/94a63487c6812548cc72e88d6eb1b8777291af87.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also made some [b]minor performance improvements[/b] and [b]fixed small bugs[/b].[/p][p]Lastly, we’re excited to let you know that a [b]Mac version of the game is in the works[/b] and will be available soon![/p]

notes.title: Day One Patch is live!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We launched a Day One Patch with some improvements based on final testing and feedback.[/p][p]🧩What’s new:[/p][list][*][p]Small level tweaks for better flow and clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved overall performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Full support for Steam Deck.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and supporting the launch![/p][p]If you run into any issues — feel free to leave feedback in the community hub.[/p][p]Stay tuned — more updates and content coming soon! 💎[/p]
